name: pos-crm-services
description: POS CRM backend: gateway, identity (Dev 1) + รันทุก service ใน services/ พร้อมกัน

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix catalog install && npm --prefix payment install && npm --prefix ../web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n identity,gateway,catalog,payment,web -c blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:identity" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:catalog" "npm run dev:payment" "npm --prefix ../web run dev"
